slides.title: A first book of the world
slides.transcript: [warmly] Allah Made It. A first book of the world, for Noah. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] Eight things you can see from where you are lying.

slides.title: And You
slides.transcript: [softly] And You. <break time="0.4s" /> The sky, the sea, the palm, the bee, the bird, the cat, the moon, the rain — and one small boy in a blanket. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Goodnight, Noah.
